description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Nimble is an AI robotics company building autonomous supply chain products. The Software Engineer will build backend services, APIs, and robotics infrastructure for robot-enabled products, collaborating with AI and other teams to support reliable operational workflows.
Software Engineer building backend APIs and orchestration services integrating multi-agent systems, cloud infrastructure, and robot-facing interfaces

Responsibilities:
• Collaborate with robotics, ML, and product teams to define requirements and turn them into well-architected software systems
• Design, build, and operate backend services and APIs that support production workflows and customer-facing features
• Own integrations between our multi-agent systems, cloud infrastructures, internal tooling, and robot-facing interfaces
• Build orchestration and state management services that coordinate long-running operational processes
• Improve reliability and scalability through robust testing, observability, incident response, and performance tuning
• Drive software engineering best practices across the team by producing high-quality, well-tested, maintainable code and raising the bar in reviews
• Mentor other engineers and contribute to improving team processes and technical standards
• Participate in and often lead design reviews, code reviews, and technical planning sessions
• Join an on-call rotation and help diagnose and resolve production issues

Requirements:
• Bachelors, Masters, or PhD in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience
• At least 1+ years of professional software engineering experience
• Strong self learning and improvement mindset
• Strong proficiency in at least one of the following programming languages: Rust, Python, C++
• Strong fundamentals in backend services, distributed systems, data modeling, and API design
• Demonstrated experience designing scalable systems and leading complex technical projects
• Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across teams

Preferred:
• Experience observability stack like OpenTelemetry
• Experience with AWS, Kubernetes, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, and production
• Experience building internal developer platforms, tooling, or workflow systems
• Exposure to automation environments such as warehousing, manufacturing, or logistics
